info.name: Substrate API Sidecar accounts blocks API
Get a range of blocks by their height.

params.name: range
params.description: A range of integers. There is a max limit of 500 blocks per request.

params.name: eventDocs
params.description: When set to `true`, every event will have an extra `docs` property with a string of the events documentation.

params.name: extrinsicDocs
params.description: When set to `true`, every extrinsic will have an extra `docs` property with a string of the extrinsics documentation.

params.name: noFees
params.description: When set to `true`, the fee won't be calculated for the extrinsics.

params.name: useEvmFormat
params.description: When set to `true`, every extrinsic's event emitted by pallet-revive will have the address data formatted to EVM.

params.name: useRcBlock
params.description: When set to `true`, the range parameter represents relay chain block numbers and the response includes additional fields for each block. Only supported for Asset Hub endpoints with relay chain API available. When used, returns an array of response objects or empty array if no Asset Hub block found.

params.name: useRcBlockFormat
params.description: Controls the response format when using 'useRcBlock=true'. When set to 'object', wraps the response in an object containing relay chain block info ('rcBlock') and the parachain data array ('parachainDataPerBlock'). When set to 'array' or omitted, returns the standard array format. Only valid when 'useRcBlock=true' is specified.

items.docs: Given a range query parameter return an array of all the blocks within that range. When `useRcBlock` parameter is used, the range represents relay chain block numbers and the response includes additional fields `rcBlockHash`, `rcBlockNumber`, and `ahTimestamp` for each block. Relay chain blocks without corresponding Asset Hub blocks are skipped.

info.name: Get a block by its height or hash.

params.name: blockId
params.description: Block identifier, as the block height or block hash.

params.name: eventDocs
params.description: When set to `true`, every event will have an extra `docs` property with a string of the events documentation.

params.name: extrinsicDocs
params.description: When set to `true`, every extrinsic will have an extra `docs` property with a string of the extrinsics documentation.

params.name: noFees
params.description: When set to `true`, the fee won't be calculated for the extrinsics.

params.name: finalizedKey
params.description: When set to false, this will override the chain-config, and omit the finalized key in the response. This can increase performance slightly by avoiding an additional RPC call to the node.

params.name: decodedXcmMsgs
params.description: When set to `true`, this will show the decoded XCM messages within the extrinsics of the requested block.

params.name: paraId
params.description: When it is set, this will return only the decoded XCM messages for the specified origin Parachain Id (originParaId). To activate this functionality, ensure that the `decodedXcmMsgs` parameter is set to true.

params.name: useRcBlock
params.description: When set to `true`, it will use the relay chain block identifier to determine the corresponding Asset Hub block. Only supported for Asset Hub endpoints with relay chain API available. When used, returns an array of response objects or empty array if no Asset Hub block found.

params.name: useRcBlockFormat
params.description: Controls the response format when using 'useRcBlock=true'. When set to 'object', wraps the response in an object containing relay chain block info ('rcBlock') and the parachain data array ('parachainDataPerBlock'). When set to 'array' or omitted, returns the standard array format. Only valid when 'useRcBlock=true' is specified.

params.name: useEvmFormat
params.description: When set to `true`, every extrinsic's event emitted by pallet-revive will have the address data formatted to EVM.

items.docs: Returns a single block. BlockId can either be a block hash or a block height. Replaces `/block/{number}` from versions < v1.0.0. When `useRcBlock` parameter is used, the response includes additional fields `rcBlockHash`, `rcBlockNumber`, and `ahTimestamp`.

info.name: Get the most recently finalized block.

params.name: finalized
params.description: Boolean representing whether or not to get the finalized head. If it is not set the value defaults to true. When set to false it will attempt to get the newest known block, which may not be finalized.

params.name: eventDocs
params.description: When set to `true`, every event will have an extra `docs` property with a string of the events documentation.

params.name: extrinsicDocs
params.description: When set to `true`, every extrinsic will have an extra `docs` property with a string of the extrinsics documentation.

params.description: When set to `true`, the fee won't be calculated for the extrinsics.

params.description: When set to `true`, this will show the decoded XCM messages within the extrinsics of the requested block.

params.name: paraId
params.description: When it is set, this will return only the decoded XCM messages for the specified origin Parachain Id (originParaId). To activate this functionality, ensure that the `decodedXcmMsgs` parameter is set to true.

params.name: useRcBlock
params.description: When set to `true`, it will use the latest relay chain block to determine the corresponding Asset Hub block. Only supported for Asset Hub endpoints with relay chain API available. Respects the `finalized` parameter when determining which relay chain block to use. When used, returns an array of response objects or empty array if no Asset Hub block found.

info.name: Get all parachain inclusion information for a relay chain block.

params.name: blockId
params.description: Relay chain block identifier, as the block height or block hash.

params.name: paraId
params.description: Optional parachain ID to filter results. When provided, only the inclusion information for the specified parachain will be returned.

items.docs: Returns all decoded parachain inclusion events (CandidateIncluded) for a relay chain block. BlockId can either be a block hash or a block height. This endpoint extracts and decodes the candidate descriptor, commitments hash, and parachain header information for each included parachain block.
